newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITV set for bumper payout from Channel 4-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITV set for bumper payout from Channel 4-paper.

text.p: British television's Channel 4 is to pay 88 million pounds ($148.6 million) this year to Independent Television (ITV) companies with Carlton Communications Plc set to receive around 28 million pounds, The Independent newspaper reported on Friday.

The payments are due under the Channel 4 funding formula which obliges the channel to pay any excess it earns from advertising revenues over and above 14 percent of total qualifying revenues in the terrestrial television sector.
Last year Channel 4 paid out 74 million pounds.
The system was put in place to ensure ITV companies were compensated for guaranteeing the viability of Channel 4 when the service was launched in 1982. ($1=.5922 Pound)
